single.rationale: IONQ shows explosive revenue growth (202% YoY, 127% CAGR) but remains deeply unprofitable with operating losses accelerating dramatically ($634M in FY2025 vs $233M in FY2024) while R&D spending reached 235% of revenue. The company operates in an extremely early-stage quantum computing market with massive technical uncertainty, unproven commercial scalability, and an astronomical valuation (113x EV/revenue) that appears disconnected from near-term fundamentals despite strong cash position from recent capital raises.
